decisions.reason: As a visible product line with several models in a core materials segment, it carries enough prior investment and public commitment that management would be inclined to continue it unless there is clear evidence of sustained failure.
This product appears close to the firm's established dental thermoforming business and was given standalone website visibility, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both favor retaining it.

Because it had lower visible commitment on the website and seems more peripheral to the firm's announced push in digital manufacturing and core custom-device workflows, management is more likely to discontinue it if results are not clearly convincing by 2022.

Even with less website prominence, this multi-model custom earmold line fits the firm's hearing-care business and likely involved meaningful product-specific know-how, which makes management more prone to keep supporting it than to admit a failed launch.
